_comment: Module map. Every tracked C++ source file belongs to exactly one module; a .cpp belongs to its header's module. 'may_include' lists what a module may include. 'file_allowed' lists libraries allowed only in named files: JSON belongs to the serializer files and the tools; the Windows headers to ui_app and the two stack-trace readers of the allocation probe; every other include of either is an include violation.

modules.name: core
modules.purpose: The ValueSource contract and the primitives every node shares; the node registry.

modules.name: contract
modules.purpose: The types that cross from performance to realization.

modules.name: source
modules.purpose: Every node type, one folder per family (filter folded in), and the list that registers them.

modules.name: patch
modules.purpose: A patch as data: the records, the declarations a type makes, the codec, the graph build.

modules.name: render
modules.purpose: Instruments, voices, mixing, a patch built as an instrument or a sound, WAV I/O.

modules.name: music
modules.purpose: The value types of music, and their codecs.

modules.name: voicing
modules.purpose: How a chord symbol is voiced: the voicing selectors and profile selectors, their registry and codec.

modules.name: compose
modules.purpose: Composition: templates and their codecs, compose, the strategies, their registry and settings, the figure builders, walkers and profiles.

modules.name: shelved
modules.purpose: Strategies kept but not built on: registered through register_shelved only.

modules.name: perform
modules.purpose: Performance: the conductor and performers, the time map, pitch gestures, the embedded score.

modules.name: play
modules.purpose: One function that runs performance and realization end to end.

modules.name: util
modules.purpose: Stand-alone analysis helpers (FFT, signal statistics).

modules.name: cli
modules.purpose: mforce_cli, the command-line renderer.

modules.name: testing
modules.purpose: The one test harness (check.h, run_tests) and the counting allocator.

modules.name: ui_model
modules.purpose: The editor's model: the open patch, its file, whether it has unsaved changes.

modules.name: ui_audio
modules.purpose: The editor's sound output: the device, the callback, the player that sounds.

modules.name: ui_control
modules.purpose: The editor's state (Session), the edit functions the views call, live play.

modules.name: ui_views
modules.purpose: The editor's windows, one class each.

modules.name: ui_app
modules.purpose: mforce_editor: the window, the frame loop.

modules.name: tests
modules.purpose: The test programs (one per module's tests folder), the allocation gate and the tool tests.

modules.name: durn
modules.purpose: durn_converter: notation formats to DURN.

modules.name: misc_tools
modules.purpose: ppl_to_json, stk_ref, wav_check.
